notes: «تابعه سليمان عن شعبة» is a mutabaʿa remark and «وقال عدي عن سعيد عن ابن عباس» names another transmitter for the same saying: both are variant groups, not routes (rule 4).
The text opens at المنهال; no name precedes him in this text, so the route starts there. «سعيد» stands twice; occurrence 1 is the main route.
